title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charles Cross (ankle) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Charles Cross (ankle) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: To no surprise, Cross is going to be sidelined for another game on Sunday. Seattle's offensive front is set to be much weaker than usual in Week 9 with him and Quenton Nelson (knee) both set to be sidelined against the Cardinals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Velus Jones Jr. (hamstring) set to play Sunday
items.desc: Velus Jones Jr. (hamstring) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: Jones has been managing a nagging hamstring issue recently, but he is set to be available to play on Sunday. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashid Shaheed (knee) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed (knee) won't play in Sunday's game against the Arizona Cardinals.
items.impact: The veteran is going to be sidelined again on Sunday as he continues to battle a knee issue of some kind. Tory Horton may see more work as a result of his absence, but that isn't likely to matter much with Drew Lock set to start at quarterback in the absence of Sam Darnold (quad/ribs) this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Hufanga missed last week's game due to an ankle injury that he's dealing with, but he is questionable and will have a chance to make his return to the lineup on Sunday. Denver's secondary will be significantly stronger if he's available to suit up and play for them in this game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brandon Jones (hamstring) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Brandon Jones (hamstring) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Jones suffered a hamstring injury in last week's game and won't be available to play on Sunday as a result. Denver's secondary will be weaker with him out of the lineup against Carolina.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Pat Bryant (ankle) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Pat Bryant (ankle) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Bryant has missed several weeks while on injured reserve, but he was able to practice in full all week and is now considered questionable to make his return on Sunday. He isn't likely to be a strong fantasy option for his first game or two back even if active, but his presence should help QB Bo Nix and Denver's offense as a whole.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) remains out for Sunday
items.desc: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) remains out for Sunday's game against the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Phillips is set to be sidelined for a third-straight game on Sunday as he continues to nurse a hamstring issue of some kind. Carolina's defensive front will be weaker with him unavailable to play in this matchup against the Broncos.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bobby Okereke (foot) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Bobby Okereke (foot) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: The veteran linebacker will be sidelined on Sunday due to a foot issue that he's managing. His absence will be less than ideal for the Panthers ahead of a matchup against the Broncos.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Damien Lewis (knee) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Damien Lewis (knee) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Denver Broncos.
items.impact: Lewis is set to be sidelined again on Sunday. He's still managing a knee issue and will need more time off in order to make a full recovery. Carolina's offensive line is dealing with several injuries right now and will likely struggle a bit against a tough Denver defensive front this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mason Taylor (back) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Mason Taylor (back) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: Taylor was limited at practice earlier in the week due to a back injury, but he's now off of the injury report and good to go for Week 9. He isn't expected to be a consistent fantasy contributor for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Bailey (groin) will play Sunday
items.desc: David Bailey (groin) will play in Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: Bailey will be available to play on Sunday. He has been dealing with a groin injury for a little while, but he seems to be back to about full health now. His return is good news for New York's defensive front.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: Hall is now off of the injury report entirely heading into the weekend, meaning that he is fully good to go and will make his return to the lineup on Sunday. He still has explosive week-to-week potential, but he may be more inconsistent moving forward now that Braelon Allen has earned more touches for himself while serving as the team's temporary RB1.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ronnie Rivers (calf) set to make return Sunday
items.desc: Ronnie Rivers (calf) is set to make his return in Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Rivers has been sidelined for most of the season while recovering from a calf issue of some kind, but he is healthy again and is set to make his return to the lineup on Sunday. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however, being relegated to a depth role behind Kyren Williams and Blake Corum for the time being.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kam Curl (foot) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Kam Curl (foot) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Curl was able to return to practice in a limited fashion on Friday, but he may still miss Sunday's game due to the foot injury that he's managing right now. That would leave Los Angeles' secondary short-handed ahead of a favorable matchup against the Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Ferguson is going to be available to play on Sunday, despite being listed on the injury report earlier in the week due to an ankle issue. He may see more involvement than usual if Colby Parkinson (ribs) is ruled out for the Rams.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee/rest) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Myles Garrett (knee/rest) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: Garrett has been sidelined since Week 1 due to a knee injury of some kind, but he is now healthy again and is set to make his return to the lineup on Sunday. His presence will offer a significant boost to Los Angeles' defensive front moving forward, even if it takes him a week or two to return to full form.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Steve Avila (hamstring) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Steve Avila (hamstring) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: A hamstring injury affected Avila's participation at practice early in the week, but it's not a serious issue and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. His presence will continue to be important for Los Angeles' offense on a week-to-week basis moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Matthew Stafford (elbow) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Matthew Stafford (elbow) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Washington Commanders.
items.impact: As expected, Stafford's elbow injury is nothing serious at this point and won't prevent him from playing on Sunday. He should be good to go, although he is harder to trust starting on a week-to-week basis now with several key pass catchers sidelined due to injury for the Rams.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dyami Brown (calf) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Dyami Brown (calf) is unavailable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Brown recently suffered a calf injury and is going to be unavailable to play on Sunday because of it. The Commanders have also ruled out Treylon Burks (foot) for that matchup, so they will likely need to lean heavily on rookie Antonio Williams in Week 9.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jer'Zhan Newton (pec) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Jer'Zhan Newton (pec) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Newton may be available to make his season debut on Sunday after spending the start of the season recovering from a procedure he underwent on his pec. His return, whenever it comes, will be a nice boost for Washington's defensive front moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Treylon Burks (foot) won't play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: The Commanders are going to be down a key wideout on Sunday, with Burks set to be sidelined due to a foot issue that he's dealing with. Dyami Brown (calf) is also set to be sidelined, so rookie Antonio Williams is expected to see a large portion of the team's targets this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacob Saylors (neck) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Jacob Saylors (neck) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Saylors is uncertain to play on Sunday due to the neck injury that he's currently recovering from. Sione Vaki (ankle) is also uncertain to play, so it looks like Detroit might not have much healthy depth behind Jahmyr Gibbs in the backfield this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sione Vaki (ankle) considered questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Sione Vaki (ankle) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Vaki is uncertain to play on Sunday, as he's currently dealing with some kind of an ankle issue. Jacob Saylors (neck) is also questionable to play, so it's uncertain who will be available to play the RB2 role behind Jahmyr Gibbs for the Lions this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Reed won't be available to play on Sunday as he recovers from a hip issue of some kind. Detroit's secondary will be weaker as a result, although it might not matter much in an easy matchup against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: The star wideout is at risk of missing Sunday's game due to a rib injury that he suffered last week. He is officially questionable to play, and if he is ruled out ahead of game time, fantasy managers should expect more work for Jameson Williams, Sam LaPorta, and Isaac TeSlaa in a matchup against Miami this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tanner McKee (rib) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Tanner McKee (rib) is questionable for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: McKee may not be available to play on Sunday, as he is officially considered questionable to play due to a rib injury. He is set to be the backup behind Joe Milton III this week, however, so his potential absence wouldn't carry much weight from a fantasy perspective.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Britain Covey (knee) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Britain Covey (knee) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Covey is going to be sidelined on Sunday as he continues to recover from a knee issue of some kind. DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) are both set to be sidelined as well, which will leave Philadelphia with a severe lack of weapons at the wide receiver position this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Barkley is still dealing with the nagging effects of a hamstring and back issue, but he carries no injury designation heading into the weekend and will play against the Giants. The team may still limit his workload, but he will continue to have explosive week-to-week upside every time he's on the field, even if that upside seems harder to attain now with Joe Milton III set to start at quarterback for the Eagles.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) won't play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Wicks is going to miss another game on Sunday. He's still recovering from an ankle injury of some kind, and it's unclear how much longer it will leave him sidelined. DeVonta Smith (hamstring) has also been ruled out, which will leave rookie Makai Lemon as Philadelphia's top wideout again this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Smith was absent from another practice on Friday and has been ruled out for Sunday's game, which comes as no surprise. It's unclear how much longer he will need to recover from this hamstring issue, and Makai Lemon is expected to be Philadelphia's WR1 again this week with both Smith and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) set to be sidelined again.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Micah Parsons (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Parsons will not be available to make his return to the lineup on Sunday, which doesn't come as much of a surprise. His next chance to play will come in Week 10 against the Vikings, and fantasy managers should expect Green Bay's defense to improve considerably whenever he's back in the lineup and full healthy for them.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Brooks (knee) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Chris Brooks (knee) is questionable for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Brooks may make his return to the lineup this week after missing and extended period of time with a knee issue. The team will make a decision about his availability closer to game time, and if he's cleared to play, he may see a decent amount of work in the event that Marshawn Lloyd (knee) is ruled out against the Patriots.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee) set to play Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Banks (knee) is set to play in Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
items.impact: As expected, Banks will be available to play on Sunday, despite having his workload managed at practice throughout the week. The team will need him and the rest of the offensive line to play well if they want to beat the Patriots on the road this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Watson (rib) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Christian Watson (rib) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Watson suffered a broken rib last week, but it's not going to prevent him from playing this week and he is officially good to go for Sunday's game. Fantasy managers should feel confident starting him this week in what projects to be a high-scoring affair in New England this weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: MarShawn Lloyd (knee) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: MarShawn Lloyd (knee) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
items.impact: The Packers may be without their backup running back on Sunday. Lloyd is dealing with a knee issue right now and is currently considered questionable to play as a result. If he's ruled out, Chris Brooks (ankle) may see more work as a result of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (foot) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka (foot) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Egbuka will head into the weekend with a questionable tag. It seems like there's a lot of optimism surrounding his status, but he is officially considered questionable to play at this point. It may be hard for fantasy managers to trust starting him this week, however, especially with him playing on Sunday night after the main slate of games.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tristan Wirfs (toe) will play Sunday
items.desc: Tristan Wirfs (toe) will play in Sunday's game against the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Wirfs was dealing with a toe issue of some kind at practice late in the week, but it's not a serious issue and won't prevent him from playing against the Bears. He remains one of the most important players on Tampa Bay's offense, so this is great news for fantasy managers with any investment in their offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: The veteran will be good to go for Sunday's game, which doesn't come as much of a surprise. He will split work with Kendre Miller this week, but it will be hard to trust starting either of them in most fantasy league formats at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: CJ Donaldson (shoulder/concussion) won't play Sunday
items.desc: CJ Donaldson (shoulder/concussion) won't play in Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Donaldson wasn't able to practice on Thursday or Friday and is going to be sidelined on Sunday as a result. Fantasy managers should expect Kendre Miller and Alvin Kamara to split the majority of touches in New Orleans' backfield this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Banks is nearing a return from an ankle injury that has left him sidelined for a long period of time. His return may come as soon as Sunday, as he is officially considered questionable to play in that matchup against Cleveland. Whenever he's back, New Orleans' offense will see a significant boost with him anchoring down the left side of their offensive line once again.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Quincy Williams (hamstring) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Quincy Williams (hamstring) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Williams' status for Week 9 seemed to be in jeopardy early in the week when he missed practice due to a hamstring issue, but he has been fully cleared and is set to play on Sunday. Cleveland's defense will need him to play well in a road matchup against a talented Saints' offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jared Verse (knee) set to play Sunday
items.desc: Jared Verse (knee) is set to play in Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Verse is set to play on Sunday, which has been expected since earlier in the week. His knee issue isn't serious at this point and shouldn't have much of an effect on his performance on the field.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (knee) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins (knee) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: The veteran lineman will be available to play on Sunday and carries no injury designation heading into the weekend. He should start and play the full game for Cleveland, assuming he doesn't suffer any setbacks with his recovery.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Austin Barber (calf) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Austin Barber (calf) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Barber will be good to go on Sunday. He missed practice early in the week with a calf injury, but it's not expected to affect his on-field performance in this matchup. Cleveland's offensive front will be stronger with him in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: It was already reported that Fannin is going to play on Sunday, but now we know that he carries no injury designation heading into the weekend, which is a good indication that he is nearly fully healthy at this point. He remains a good TE option with boom potential in a matchup against the Saints this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Denzel Boston (calf) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Denzel Boston (calf) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: As expected, the rookie's calf injury is nothing more than a minor issue at this point and won't prevent him from playing in Week 9. He's still a risky fantasy option on a week-to-week basis, however, especially with Shedeur Sanders set to be Cleveland's starting quarterback this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (thumb) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (thumb) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Stevenson was healthy at practice all week until Friday, when he was a limited participant due to a thumb injury. It will leave him questionable to play heading into the weekend, and Chicago's secondary will be weaker than usual if he's not able to suit up and play on Sunday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) is questionable to play in Sunday night's game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Monangai has been out for several weeks while managing these two injuries, but he is questionable and will have a chance to make his return to the lineup on Sunday night. We won't know whether or not that's the case until closer to game time, but his workload would be less than ideal for the workload of D'Andre Swift moving forward and would push Roschon Johnson back to RB3 in the team's rotation.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: KaVontae Turpin (ribs) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: KaVontae Turpin (ribs) will be unavailable for Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Turpin is set to be sidelined for another game while he recovers from an injury to his ribs. His absence will be felt more if George Pickens (hamstring) is also unavailable to play for the Cowboys on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Downs (concussion/ankle) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Caleb Downs (concussion/ankle) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: The rookie is going to be available to play on Sunday. He was previously going through the NFL's concussion protocols and was managing an ankle issue, but neither of those things will prevent him from playing. Dallas' secondary will be stronger with him present.
